intent: Apply highest policy-allowed service_recovery discount to the most recent checkoutable basket of the given customer.
success_criteria: Customer resolved from email to a customer_id
Last checkoutable basket selected by max basket_created_at
Discount percent equals the service_recovery cap stated in the discount policy doc
Discount applied via /bin/discount with issuer = current identity employee_id
Answer references the basket record path and the discount policy doc

args: SELECT b.basket_id, b.record_path, b.basket_status, b.basket_created_at, b.customer_id FROM shopping_baskets b JOIN customer_accounts c ON c.customer_id = b.customer_id WHERE c.customer_email = :email AND b.basket_status IN ('open','active','checkoutable') ORDER BY b.basket_created_at DESC LIMIT 1;

agents_md_constraints.rule: use discount tool to manage basket discounts
id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.

answer_template.message: Applied service_recovery discount of $max_service_recovery_pct% (policy cap) to basket $basket_id at $basket_path for holger.arnold+cust917@yahoo.com. Issuer: $issuer_employee_id. Policy: $discount_doc_path.
